newTerms.modern mountain-building stage: etapa moderna de formación de montañas

forcedChoices.reason: The English speaks to the reader; the Spanish rules ask for the plural ustedes.

forcedChoices.choice: las aguas frías de los mares del norte
forcedChoices.reason: "cooling waters" can mean waters that cool other waters or waters that are cold; "frías" is the plain form that keeps the effect on temperature without an added clause.

forcedChoices.choice: Hace 75 000 000 años se marca el fin
forcedChoices.reason: The English uses a time phrase as the subject; Spanish cannot do this, so an impersonal verb keeps the sentence and the emphasis on the number.
Spanish forces a gender; the masculine generic form refers to the type of bird, not to the noun criatura.
"many colored" can mean many-colored or many layers that are colored; the Spanish keeps both readings open as far as it can.
The English links the name Cretaceous to chalk; the Spanish "cretácico" also comes from "creta", so no English word in parentheses is necessary.
